description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Rogue], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Wind, Poison)], [Quick Cast 2] and [Stealthy Prowl Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Rogue
description.text: Thief and Celerity abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief and Celerity abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Wind, Poison)

description.name: Stealthy Prowl Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Stealthy Prowl after using two Thief or Celerity abilities
